{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Confirm the revenue column
revenue_col = 'revenue'  # confirmed from prior inspection

# Filter for completed orders
completed_orders = sales_df[sales_df['status'] == 'completed']

# Check if any rows have non-zero revenue
print("Number of completed orders:", completed_orders.shape[0])
print("Revenue values in completed orders:", completed_orders[revenue_col].head())

# Compute the actual sum of revenue
actual_sum = completed_orders[revenue_col].sum()
print("Actual sum of revenue:", actual_sum)

# Return the final value
actual_sum"}
